• Kati 0

description_en: Commercial premises for sale in the "21 Dhjetori" area, Tirana with a very favorable position, in one of the most dynamic spots and with the highest demand for businesses. Ambienti ka një sipërfaqe 70m². Main features: • Floor 0 • 70 m² Glass facade along the entire length, offering high visibility Advantages of the area: • One of the most populated and frequented areas of the capital • Presence of consolidated businesses around • Immediate access to Tirana Ring Road and the city center • High investment potential thanks to the constant demand for commercial rent Regular documentation.
